# gitmoap_repository_push_rules (Data Source)

Get effective push rules for a repository (resolved with group inheritance). The checks a push to the repository must pass — signed commits, a work-item reference, a maximum file size, patterns for commit messages, author emails and forbidden file names — as they apply here: the repository's own values, then the nearest group's for each it leaves unset. A rule a group above enforces holds whatever is set beneath. Anyone who can see the repository may read them.

The token needs `push_rule:read`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "gitmoap_repository_by_path" "api" {
  full_path = "acme/platform/api"
}

data "gitmoap_repository_push_rules" "api" {
  repo_id = data.gitmoap_repository_by_path.api.repository_id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `repo_id` (String) Repository ID

### Read-Only

- `author_email_regex` (String)
- `commit_message_regex` (String)
- `max_file_size_mb` (Number)
- `prohibited_file_names_regex` (String)
- `reject_unsigned_commits` (Boolean)
- `require_closing_issue_reference` (Boolean) Stricter: the reference must carry an intent to *close* (`Fixes #412`), not merely
mention. Implies `require_issue_reference`.
- `require_issue_reference` (Boolean) Whether every pushed commit must reference a work item. A push with a commit that does not is
rejected as a whole.
